topic: UFC legend Zhang Weili effortlessly lifts NBA legend Shaquille O'Neal in the gym, shocking him.

hook.first_words: This UFC legend is about to try lifting Shaq
hook.first_frame: Shaq standing in a gym posing while Zhang Weili approaches to lift him with text on screen.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: THIS UFC LEGEND IS ABOUT TO TRY LIFTING SHAQ

shots.shows: Zhang Weili bending down and successfully lifting Shaq in the gym.
Shaq reacting in utter shock and laughing after being lifted.

music.style: upbeat viral short background track with dramatic swell

ending.last_words: Shaq and Weili celebrating and fist bumping
ending.last_frame: Shaq smiling and posing with Weili in the gym with a skull emoji overlay

script: This UFC legend is about to try lifting Shaq, and even Shaq didn't believe she could pull it off. He's over 300 pounds and stands 7'1, while Zhang Weili is only 5'4 and around 125 pounds. But this was the moment she completely shocked him.
what_makes_it_work: Extreme size contrast between the two athletes creates immediate intrigue
High-stakes physical feat performed effortlessly by the smaller fighter
Genuine, priceless reaction of shock and joy from Shaquille O'Neal
